summary: Implemented the progress-tracked file reading feature in rich/progress.py: added a private _Reader class (io.RawIOBase subclass that advances a Progress task on reads and resets position on seek), Progress.read(file, total=None, task_id=None, description="Reading...") for paths or file objects (total required for file objects), and a module-level rich.progress.read wrapper that starts its own Progress and stops it on close. Added a CHANGELOG entry. Nothing was run or tested, no tests were added, and nothing was committed.
